newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing tells HK democratic activists to leave.
newsitem.headline: Beijing tells HK democratic activists to leave.

text.p: Beijing police have ordered two Hong Kong residents to leave China after they were detained for distributing materials to journalists, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Hong Kong sources said the two were political activists who had come to Beijing to present a petition to officials of the Chinese cabinet's Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office regarding political developments in the British colony.
The two Hong Kong residents were Wong Chung-ki and and Chui Pak-tai.
Xinhua said hotel officials had filed a public disturbance complaint against the two for distributing materials in the main hall of the Beijing Asia Hotel on Thursday evening.
"The Beijing Public Security Department issued a warning to Chui and Wong, asking them to return (to) Hong Kong within a stated time," Xinhua said.
Chinese authorities had barred two other Hong Kong pro-democracy advocates from entering the country on Thursday, one of the activists said in Hong Kong.
